products.name: Photoroom
products.note: AI photo editing; background removal; e-commerce focus; EU data handling

profile_text.body:
Photoroom is an AI-powered photo editing tool and listing studio aimed at e-commerce businesses and social media creators. The company describes itself as offering professional-quality visual production from a phone, with features including background removal, background replacement, object removal, clothing recoloring, image resizing, and AI-generated shadows. It also offers tools specifically oriented toward product photography, such as a Ghost Mannequin feature, Flat Lay, Product Beautifier, and a Product Video Generator.

For larger organizations, Photoroom provides API access, batch and bulk editing workflows, and custom AI models with dedicated support, positioning the platform for catalogue-scale visual production. The site states the background removal tool is trusted by more than 80 million users, and quotes a customer describing six-figure savings and a reduction of image workload to a quarter through automation. A Photoroom MCP server is listed among its current offerings, indicating integration with model context protocol tooling.

The site notes that Photoroom handles EU data, which is reflected in the held facts alongside its e-commerce focus. No litigation or SEC filings appear in the available data.
